verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a managed sandbox platform, so the axis applies. The pack only shows that the SDK (github.com/sandbox0-ai/sdk-go) and the CLI (github.com/sandbox0-ai/s0) are hosted on GitHub. Nothing names an open license, and nothing shows the core platform's source is public, so there is no evidence the product's source is readable under an open license.
